concerns.text: FR‑011 (README with usage instructions) is not fully covered – task T112 (update README with explicit data‑source error message) is still pending, leaving the required documentation incomplete.
SC‑001 (R² ≥ 0.6) is only logged by task T066; there is no verification task that asserts the threshold is met, so the success criterion is not enforced.
SC‑002 (|r| ≥ 0.5) is only logged by task T067; no verification step checks that the absolute Pearson correlation meets the required threshold.

SC‑006 (top‑5 feature ranking stability) lacks a completed verification task – T069a/T069b are incomplete and T109 (stability verification script) is still pending, leaving the stability criterion untested.
SC‑008 (lint warnings ≤ 5) is not enforced – T032a_verify only asserts ≤ 5 lint **errors**, not warnings, and no task checks the warning count against the limit.
Task T091 verifies presence of FR/SC identifiers in spec and plan, but does not enforce that each FR/SC has an associated implementation task; this verification alone does not guarantee coverage.
